# 0.2.3 - LTS maintenance baseline 11.2026

This maintenance release fixes receiver availability and command handling,
and verifies the Home Assistant companion against real HA Core.

- Corrupt serial replies no longer mark the receiver online or cancel retries.
- Explicit profiles, underscored input keys and command aliases now resolve
  correctly. Input selects exclude unsupported commands for their zone.
- Receiver errors remain visible, retries respect UART spacing, and typed
  volume steps cannot be repeated accidentally after a lost report.
- Companion updates run on HA's event loop; missing availability sensors,
  invalid entity bindings and invalid volume values are handled defensively.
- The companion example uses the existing ESPHome media player for power/mute.
- CI now compiles real raw-command lambdas, tests production C++ under memory
  sanitizers, and exercises HA events, services and listener cleanup.

The pinned runtime baseline is ESPHome 2026.10.1 and Home Assistant
2026.10.4, the stable versions available on November 1. The 11.2026 label is
the project's maintenance date; it is not an upstream version requirement.
Minimum versions remain ESPHome and HA 2026.9.0. See SUPPORT.md for scope.

No firmware is installed automatically. Receiver-family hardware validation
remains partial; compiled tests do not certify every command on every model.
